articles.title: Somali daycare owner whose business was linked to Minnesota taxpayer fraud wins seat in state legislature
articles.summary: Somali-born daycare owner Abdi Daisane has won a seat in Minnesota's legislature despite mounting scrutiny of his taxpayer-funded childcare business.

articles.title: Canada to grant permanent residency to 200,000 temporary residents by 2027
articles.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney's government plans a one-time transition for up to 200,000 temporary residents to permanent status by the end of 2027, over and above its annual immigration targets

articles.title: Haitian boy, 8, detained during scheduled immigration appointment
articles.summary: Homeland Security said the uncle did not have legal custody so it took the boy under an 2008 anti-human trafficking law “out of an abundance of caution.”

articles.title: What Stephen Miller has pushed for while in Trump administration
articles.summary: Top Trump adviser Stephen Miller, who is set to take over the White House chief of staff role on Monday, has driven President Trump's most controversial immigration policies during both of his administrations.
